_comment: Copy to config.json. Every field is optional — the no-key providers work with an empty file. Add a key for any provider you have an account with and its models join the chain automatically.
_keys_comment: provider id -> key, or a LIST of keys which are rotated one per call

keys.github_models: ghp_... (a GitHub token with the models scope)

_multi_key_example: three Gemini keys become 4,500 requests/day instead of 1,500
